verdict.rationale: Pendo's built-in AI assistant, Leo, accepts natural-language requests and can take action by building guides and segments inside the same conversation. It also monitors continuously and sends alerts in Pendo, so users can hand it real tasks rather than just ask questions. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the range of delegable actions beyond guides and segments, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the delegation works as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Ask questions in natural language and take action by building guides and segments inside the same conversation.
Leo monitors continuously. Get alerts in Pendo and Slack when something shifts -without having to go looking for it.
